related_questions.question: What is the expected inflation rate for the next 5 years?

text_blocks.snippet: Projected inflation rates for the next five years vary depending on the source and specific economic factors, but generally indicate a gradual decline. For example, Goldman Sachs forecasts core inflation to be 3.3% in 2025, falling to 2.7% in 2026 and 2.4% in 2027. The International Monetary Fund (IMF) predicts global headline inflation will fall to 2.8% by the end of 2024 and 2.4% in 2025. Another source, YCharts, indicates the 5-Year, 5-Year Forward Inflation Expectation Rate is currently at 2.32%.
